Riftn: The old internet cracks. New ground rises. The open source social media protocol you own.

The name

Riftn is the ultimate disruption event. The name is short for rifting, the geological process that rips the earth's crust apart, unleashes violent volcanic eruptions and forms new seas, land and life. Every rift breaks something old and builds something new. Our name carries that idea: disruption creates.

The problem

Two decades ago, a few companies fenced off the internet. They own your audience, your reach and your income. One policy change erases everything. Million-follower creators vanish overnight, rules unbroken. Their mistake? Building on rented ground.

What we build

Riftn cracks that ground open: an open source, user-owned social media protocol. Anyone can build on it, fork it or plug into it. Our own apps already run on it: video, shorts, live streams, music, encrypted messaging, communities, games and a built-in wallet. Mint any upload straight to your wallet. Keep up to 99% of what you earn. Time orders your feed, not a secret algorithm. Your handle, @you@riftn.com, travels the open web.

Built on request

Ownership means more than keeping your posts. On Riftn, anyone can request anything: a feature, a game, a whole new experience. We build it. If it suits everyone, it ships as a default. If it suits only you, it lives in your personal settings. One protocol, a million versions. Hyper-personalisation is the internet's next stage. True ownership makes it possible. Riftn could become the final frontier for consumer social, and we designed it to sustain itself for eons. Why build an alternative when everyone already builds this one together? Fair question. And if you still want to, go ahead: everything is fully open source.

Zero crypto friction

No seed phrases. No gas fees. No wallet setup. Sign in with Google, Apple, email or phone, and Riftn creates your wallet instantly. It feels familiar. Underneath, the blockchain records everything.

Why we exist

Gamers, streamers and developers, fed up with censorship and mainstream brainwashing, launched the protocol in 2021 under the FTV name. At launch it generated over $4M in revenue. We shared $1M with token holders, put $1M into development and a five-year roadmap runway, and spent $2M in BNB buying back and burning our own token. Verify every number on the blockchain and on our stats page. FTV became DeHub, and in November 2026, DeHub became Riftn. Same team, same fight, bigger mission. The new Riftn token launches soon. It doesn't trade yet.

The invitation

New land has no landlords. Claim yours before anyone draws the map. Then explore the technology, token and apps driving the rift.

Important Notice (Disclaimer): Riftn tokens serve as utility tokens within our ecosystem, similar to in-game currencies, and are not investment vehicles. While our blockchain infrastructure provides unprecedented transparency and verifiable on-chain data for educational purposes, all markets carry inherent risks. You could lose your entire investment due to market volatility, technical issues, security breaches, or unforeseen circumstances. Only participate with funds you can afford to lose completely.
